exs: The consul helped stranded students replace their lost passports. 领事帮助滞留学生补办丢失的护照。
The consul, who had served abroad for years, spoke fluent Spanish. 曾在海外任职多年的领事说一口流利的西班牙语。

defs.cn: 弄污, 弄脏, 污染, 毒害；[化] 污染

words.root: con（一起）+ tam（他）→ 一起脏→污染
exs: The factory contaminated the river with toxic waste. 工厂用有毒废料污染了河流。
Leaking from underground tanks, the chemical contaminated nearby wells, forcing residents to buy bottled water. 从地下储罐泄漏后，这种化学物质污染了附近的水井，迫使居民购买瓶装水。

defs.cn: 污染, 污物；[化] 污染; 沾污

words.root: con-（一起）+ tamin（触）→ 共同沾污 → 污染
exs: Contamination from industrial waste severely damaged the river ecosystem. 工业废料造成的污染严重破坏了河流生态系统。
The researchers warned that contamination spreading through groundwater could threaten nearby villages. 研究人员警告说，通过地下水蔓延的污染可能威胁附近村庄。
